summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice on August 17, 2026. Based on its Form 20-F, the company reported net losses of US$5.76M and US$5.73M for fiscal years ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and no longer meets Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b) alternatives (US$2.5M stockholders' equity or US$35M market value). The company has until October 1, 2026 to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, Nasdaq may grant up to 180 days extension. Listing continues pending plan review. Watch for plan submission and potential alternatives to regain compliance.
